$comment: SDS registry. We index manufacturer-hosted sheets; we never mirror them — see docs/SPEC.md, 'SDS generator — link out, never mirror'. manufacturerSdsUrl is the manufacturer's own SDS page and is the durable link. directSdsUrl is only ever filled in once a human has opened it and confirmed it is the sheet for THIS product. Entries with neither are still listed in the hazard inventory, because WorkSafeBC requires the inventory whether or not we can link the sheet.

products.name: Cafiza Espresso Machine Cleaner
products.hazardSummary: Alkaline cleaning powder. Causes serious eye damage and skin irritation. Wear eye protection and gloves; do not mix with other chemicals.

products.name: Cafiza Espresso Machine Cleaning Tablets
products.hazardSummary: Alkaline cleaning tablet. Causes serious eye damage and skin irritation. Keep out of reach of children.

products.name: Rinza Milk Frother Cleaner
products.hazardSummary: Alkaline liquid for milk lines and steam wands. Irritating to eyes and skin. Never mix with acidic descaler.

products.name: Dezcal Descaler
products.hazardSummary: Acidic descaling powder (sulfamic/citric acid based). Irritating to eyes and skin. Never mix with bleach or alkaline cleaners.

products.name: Grindz Grinder Cleaner
products.hazardSummary: Food-safe grinder cleaning granules. Low hazard; check the current sheet for your batch.

products.name: Puly Caff Verde
products.hazardSummary: Alkaline espresso machine cleaning powder. Causes serious eye damage. Wear eye protection.

products.name: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer
products.hazardSummary: Concentrate is corrosive; in-use dilution is far lower hazard. Never mix with bleach.
products.sourceNote: Brand varies by café. Get the sheet from whoever supplies your sanitizer.

products.name: Sodium hypochlorite (bleach)
products.hazardSummary: Corrosive. Releases toxic chlorine gas if mixed with acids or ammonia. Never mix with descaler or quat sanitizer.
products.sourceNote: Brand varies by café. Get the sheet from your janitorial supplier.

products.name: Commercial dishwasher detergent
products.hazardSummary: Highly alkaline. Causes severe skin burns and eye damage. Handle with gloves and eye protection.
products.sourceNote: Usually supplied by your dish machine servicer — ask them for the current sheet.

products.name: Kitchen degreaser
products.hazardSummary: Alkaline. Irritating to eyes, skin and airways. Ventilate when spraying.

products.name: Caustic drain cleaner
products.hazardSummary: Corrosive, causes severe burns. Never mix with other drain products. Only for trained staff.

products.name: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) cylinder
products.hazardSummary: Compressed gas under pressure. Asphyxiation risk in enclosed spaces. Secure cylinders upright; never move with the regulator attached.
products.sourceNote: Your gas supplier issues the sheet. Only applicable if you carbonate or pour nitro.
